evals.name: incomplete-run
evals.prompt: The candidate compiles but some selected examples did not execute. Decide whether to accept it.
evals.expected_output: Inspect named outcomes and distinguish unsupported from passed.
assertions: Compares selected, executed and unsupported counts.
Does not accept unsupported outcomes as passing examples.

evals.name: failed-baseline
evals.prompt: The baseline compilation failed. Did this candidate remove all agent exposure?
evals.expected_output: Refuse to compare an unknown side as empty.
assertions: Requires successful compilation of both complete models.
Checks scope changes in the semantic diff.
Separates agent exposure from caller authorization.

evals.name: missing-expectation
evals.prompt: The renamed input compiles and tests pass, but the changed example is shorter. Review it.
assertions: Traces the rename through the production mapping.
Separates removed assertions from deleted seed data.
Runs retained examples and checks the expected destination remains covered.
